description: This file defines classes and functions related to unit types, animations, attack types, and game data for the Wesnoth game, including parsing configuration data and managing unit properties.

classes.name: unit_animation
classes.description: Handles animation frames and sound effects for units.

classes.name: attack_type
classes.description: Represents attack properties including animations, damage, range, and special effects.

classes.name: unit_movement_type
classes.description: Defines movement costs, defense modifiers, and resistance for different terrain types.

classes.name: unit_type
classes.description: Encapsulates properties and behaviors of a unit, including attacks, animations, traits, and advancements.

classes.name: game_data
classes.description: Holds the overall game configuration data, including unit types, races, and movement types.

methods.name: unit_animation::get_first_frame_time
methods.description: Returns the time of the first frame for a given animation type.

methods.name: unit_animation::get_last_frame_time
methods.description: Returns the time of the last frame for a given animation type.

methods.name: attack_type::animation
methods.description: Retrieves an animation for a specific attack direction.

methods.name: unit_type::add_advancement
methods.description: Adds an advancement path from this unit type to another.

methods.name: game_data::set_config
methods.description: Initializes game data from configuration, including units, races, and movement types.
